lint.config:
version: "2"
linters:
  default: standard # errcheck, govet, ineffassign, staticcheck, unused
  enable:
    - bodyclose # unclosed HTTP response bodies
    - copyloopvar # loop variable copies made redundant by Go 1.22
    - durationcheck # time.Duration multiplied by time.Duration
    - errorlint # errors.Is/As and %w instead of ==, type assertions and %v
    - gosec # security: file permissions, subprocesses, path handling
    - intrange # range over an integer instead of a counting loop
    - misspell # misspelled English in comments and strings
    - nilerr # returning a nil error after checking a non-nil one
    - noctx # network and exec calls without a context
    - nolintlint # every //nolint names its linter and says why
    - usetesting # t.TempDir, t.Setenv and t.Context over their os and context counterparts
  settings:
    errcheck:
      exclude-functions:
        - golang.org/x/sys/windows.CloseHandle
    gosec:
      excludes:
        - G104
        - G204
        - G304
        - G703
    nolintlint:
      require-explanation: true
      require-specific: true
    staticcheck:
      checks:
        - all
        - -ST1005
        - -ST1000
        - -ST1003
        - -ST1016
        - -QF1001
        - -QF1008
  exclusions:
    presets:
      - std-error-handling
    rules:
      - path: (_test\.go|internal/worker/workertest/)
        linters:
          - gosec
      - linters:
          - noctx
        text: os/exec.Command must not be called
      - path: internal/worker/proc_windows\.go
        linters:
          - gosec
        text: G103|G115
issues:
  max-issues-per-linter: 0
  max-same-issues: 0
